description: Make a local folder reachable through this agent's tunnel. Omit access for a public share, or set its closed password, ip_allowlist, or sign_in access policy. The path must be an existing directory; absolute paths and ~/ paths are accepted, while relative paths are refused when the caller's working directory is unknown. Creates (or updates by name) a tunnel-only local-directory frontend at <name>.<assigned domain>, waits up to 30 s for a public domain, and returns public_url, local_target, frontend_id and account. Directory listings are off unless index=true. The share is temporary and is withdrawn by unexpose, agent stop, or local-socket close; it is never saved to the agent's config file. When this connection has applied a project file, the share is also saved to that file (project_file says whether), except a share with a generated password, which is live and not saved. A password the user typed (ask the user for it, never invent one) is stored on this computer under a readable name, the file holds only that name, and password_stored says which: tell the user the name, never repeat the password. If it cannot be stored the share stays live and unsaved; a folder outside the project's directory is live and not saved. A previewed project is never written.

password.description:
Password for HTTP Basic authentication, as the user typed it: ask
the user for it, never invent one. A strong password is generated
when omitted and returned once in the exposure result.

cidrs.description: CIDR networks allowed to reach the share.

anyOf.description:
Sign in with a Cruma account, the agent's built-in provider. All three
restrictions are optional; with none, any verified Cruma account is
admitted. An email or domain listed here admits its account; with an
organization set the account must also belong to it, which needs a
signed-in agent.

organization.description: Public id of the one Cruma organization whose members are allowed.

anyOf.description:
Closed, temporary access policies for an MCP share. These are translated
into frontend-only middleware and never become persistent configuration.

access.description: Optional temporary access policy. Omit it to leave the share public.

name.description: Subdomain label for the public hostname. Default: `directory-<basename>`.

path.description: Existing directory to serve. Absolute and `~/` paths are accepted.

name: expose_local_directory
